notes:
Budget: all 8 WebSearch calls used and about 40 of 60 WebFetch calls used. Robots.txt checked on each new site; none disallowed the pages used. Several official pages returned errors and were replaced by other official pages: paxunplugged.com (fetch failed, used unplugged.paxsite.com), paxsite.com (certificate mismatch), nationalsportscollectorsconvention.com (wrong host, used nsccshow.com), Rosemont venue event page (404). East PAX event-info page returned 404, so PAX East details come from east.paxsite.com home only.

COLLECT-A-CON VENDOR RULES (dates skipped per brief): one full island of 10 tables maximum per company or person per show; orders above 10 may be cancelled with a 10 percent fee. Reselling, trading or transferring tables is prohibited. Standard table is 6 feet by 30 inches; 6 by 12, 6 by 24 and 8 by 30 may be used depending on the venue. Unauthorized tables cost 150 each, charged at the event. Cancellation requests must come at least 30 days before the event; approved refunds carry a 10 percent fee and later cancellations get no refund. Adhesive stickers, tape or decals on venue floors or walls need written approval, with a 2,000 fine for violations. Published vendor contact: info@collectaconusa.com. Prices and 2027 vendor applications were not published on the site. The homepage lists 900 plus vendor tables in a featuring list, not tied to one show.

KEY CONFLICTS AND CAVEATS: (1) TCG National: the listing gives Jan 21 to 24 and 2 pm to 8 pm hours, but a nearby-shows card says Jan 23 at 10 am, so hours are left out. No official site was found; an aggregator claims about 1,400 vendor tables, not recorded. (2) National 2027 venue is spelled Donald Stephenson Center on the future events page and Donald E. Stephens Convention Center on the 2026 page and the Chicago organizer page; recorded as Donald E. Stephens. (3) Gen Con exhibitors page heading says 2027 but its browser title says 2025; dates Aug 5 to 8 2027 are on the homepage. (4) PAX East 2027 page says news is coming and details may change.

UNVERIFIED AGGREGATOR TABLE COUNTS, NOT RECORDED: National 2027 about 1,000 tables; Toronto fall 2026 about 500 tables; Chicago Sports Spectacular about 400 tables; PAX Unplugged 2025 more than 300 exhibitors (year unclear).

PAST EDITION NOT RECORDED: The Philly Show Sept 25 to 27, 2026 (Oaks, PA). A PhillyVoice article dated 2026-08-22 gives more than 300 dealers and more than 1,000 tables for that edition (pre-show press figure). It is not written as a separate record because the schema has no held status; use it when weighing crowd size.

NOT RESEARCHED: Spring 2027 Toronto expo dates are not published; the organizer has run spring and fall editions. Card vendor presence at Gen Con, Origins, PAX West, PAX East and PAX Unplugged is not stated on their official pages. No record for the 2029 Chicago National (July 25 to 29, 2029) because it is beyond the next two editions.
